outcome: Rate of preterm birth (<37 weeks' gestation)
Rate of preterm birth (<34 weeks' gestation)
Rate of preterm birth (<28 weeks' gestation)
Average week of gestation at birth
cohort: The study included 47 singleton pregnant patients without a prior history of preterm birth or infection/inflammation, who presented with a cervical length <25 mm.
finding: Performing an ultrasound-indicated cerclage in cases of a short cervical length <25 mm without a prior history of preterm birth and infection/inflammation reduces the rates of preterm birth (<37 and <34 weeks' gestation) and the hospitalization period.
gest_age: Outcomes were assessed as rates of preterm birth at <37, <34, and <28 weeks' gestation, and the average week of gestation at birth.
